title: 3D Flanged Mace
description: This is a resource pack after the model of a 'flanged mace'.
body:
This is a recreation of a flanged mace revived into Minecraft! This works from version **1.21.6** to the latest version. These personal project of mine take some time, I hope that many people will see it and download it. I will be making more of these in the future :]
![This is a preview of the 3d mace that I have made](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/80d1aaf03a331183f63c55b502673de18aad412c.png)![3D Flanged Mace Ver.1.0](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/748015cab4b9fae0b788c68ce184a7f53b59228e.png)
